svg.text: The miniature's numbers. Top: Learn-to-Steer's loop on the latent. Bottom: one capped push on the product's prediction.
Chance of "left of" going into each of Learn-to-Steer's 16 updates, step size 5
update number; the final chance, after update 15, is on the right
One push on the product's prediction, then one DDIM step
One sampler step, change in the latent due to steering: 0.2640 with the capped push, 6.0072 with the 16 updates.
The two are not a fair race: the weights are hand-set and the step sizes are the methods' own. The gap shows why a dose must be tested before a head is judged.
